message:
The build environment doesn't persist /tmp between calls. Let me create the driver file and build in a single call.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'echo "#include <stdint.h>" > /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "#include <stdio.h>" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "#include <stdlib.h>" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size);" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "int main(int argc, char** argv) {" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "    if(argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, \"usage: %s <input_file>\n\", argv[0]); return 1; }" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "    FILE* f = fopen(argv[1], \"rb\");" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "    if(!f) { perror(\"fopen\"); return 1; }" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "    long sz = ftell(f);" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "    uint8_t* buf = malloc(sz);" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "    if(fread(buf, 1, sz, f) != (size_t)sz) { perror(\"fread\"); return 1; }" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "    fclose(f);" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "    LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(buf, sz);" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "    free(buf);" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "    return 0;" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && echo "}" >> /tmp/test_driver.c && gcc -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -I /gt/_work/src/src /tmp/test_driver.c /gt/_work/src/test/fuzzers/fuzz-mdhtml.c /gt/_work/src/src/md4c.c /gt/_work/src/src/md4c-html.c /gt/_work/src/src/entity.c -o /tmp/fuzz-mdhtml 2>&1 && echo BUILD_OK'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
